test_trainer_evaluate: test the Trainer.evaluate method to compute loss and custom metrics on a regression dataset
test_trainer_predict: test the Trainer.predict method to generate predictions and retrieve predictions and label IDs from eval dataset
test_train_predict_loss_parity: test that training_step and prediction_step compute the same loss for identical inputs
test_batch_eval_metrics: test Trainer.evaluate and Trainer.predict with batch_eval_metrics enabled to compute metrics over the full eval set at once
test_fp16_full_eval: test fp16_full_eval flag reduces GPU memory allocation by half during evaluation on supported accelerators
test_bf16_full_eval: test bf16_full_eval flag reduces GPU memory allocation by half during evaluation on supported accelerators
test_eval_use_gather_object: test eval_use_gather_object flag to gather objects for metrics computation during evaluate and predict
test_preprocess_logits_for_metrics: test preprocess_logits_for_metrics callback to modify logits before metric computation during evaluation
test_trainer_eval_multiple: test Trainer.evaluate with multiple named datasets to return separate loss metrics per dataset
